title: Add disk-space guard and target/ cleanup for job workspaces
summary: Add a configurable minimum-free-disk check (default 10G) before jobs and verifications. On low space it runs cleanup (delete target/ of terminal jobs' workspaces and idle ones), and if still low it holds the job as 'environment: low disk' and tells the operator. Then re-run job 20261017-044847-hem1's request, which failed only because the verifier's disk was full. The audience is the operator who runs the drain loop.

defaults_applied.how: Tests added for cleanup, hold, and resume; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Criteria check hold, cleanup, and resume behavior by running the tests.
Use an existing crate for the free-space query if one is already a dependency or is well maintained.
The disk guard is enforced in code, not in prose.
Handles the full-disk cause of hem1's failed verification, not that one instance.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The job id in the request is 20261016-044847-hem1, as the referenced job shows. The re-run is a separate follow-up that Athena queues after this lands; this change does not edit the planning code.
The disk probe is injectable so tests can simulate low disk without filling a real disk.
A held job is retried automatically on a later drain pass once space is free.
Prefer an existing maintained crate for the free-space query over hand-written FFI (buy-first).

acceptance_criteria.text: With free disk simulated below the minimum, a test shows the cleanup runs first. Run `cargo test --locked` and check that the new disk tests pass.
A test shows that when space is still low after cleanup, the job is held with status 'environment: low disk', not rejected, and the operator is told. Run `cargo test --locked`.
A test shows that once space is freed, a held job's verification goes ahead. Run `cargo test --locked`.

A test shows that a job workspace's target/ directory is deleted when the job reaches a terminal state, and that idle workspaces are swept. Source files in the workspace remain. Run `cargo test --locked`.
The minimum free space is a configuration value in athena.toml with a default of 10G. The documentation names it, and the athena.toml change is listed as a deliverable.
`cargo clippy --all-targets --locked` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
Job 20261016-044847-hem1's request is re-run after the change lands. Its verification cites the commands that ran for each behavior criterion (the former criterion 7).

out_of_scope: Changing the planning pass itself that hem1 requested
Deleting anything other than target/ build caches in job workspaces
departures: The change spans the run loop, config, and new tests, and includes a re-run request, so cost and time are above the reference. Passing is less likely because the verifier's disk may be full again.
